description_en: Creates a product distribution task to distribute a specified product to a specified target instance
description_zh: 调用该接口创建产品分发任务，将指定产品分发到指定的目标实例
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-product-distribute-job --source-instance-id iot-cn-st2000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --target-instance-id iot-cn-6ja000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateProductDistributeJob

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source instance to which the product belongs.

Public instance IDs for each region:

    - China (Shanghai): iotx-oxssharez200.
    - Japan: iotx-oxssharez300.
    - Singapore: iotx-oxssharez400.
    - US (Silicon Valley): iotx-oxssharez500.
    - US (Virginia): iotx-oxssharez600.
    - Germany (Frankfurt): iotx-oxssharez700.

Enterprise instance ID:
    
    1. Log on to the IoT Platform console and select a region from the drop-down list in the upper-left corner of the top navigation bar.
    
    2. On the Overview page, click the instance name. On the Instance Details page, view the Instance ID in the Basic Information section
parameters.help_zh:
产品所属的源实例ID。

各地域公共实例ID：

    - 华东2（上海）：iotx-oxssharez200。
    - 日本：iotx-oxssharez300。
    - 新加坡：iotx-oxssharez400。
    - 美国（硅谷）：iotx-oxssharez500。
    - 美国（弗吉尼亚）：iotx-oxssharez600。
    - 德国（法兰克福）：iotx-oxssharez700。

企业版实例ID：
    
    1. 登录物联网平台控制台，从顶部导航栏左上方的下拉菜单选择地域。
    
    2. 在实例概览页面，单击实例名称，在实例详情页面的实例基本信息中查看实例ID。
parameters.name: source_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to be distributed
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target instance to which the product is distributed. For more information about instance IDs, see the description of the SourceInstanceId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 产品分发的目标实例ID。实例ID详情，请参见参数SourceInstanceId描述
parameters.name: target_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the product belongs. To view the account ID, log on to the IoT Platform console, click the profile picture, and go to the Basic Information page to view the Account ID.

You must specify at least one of the TargetUid and TargetAliyunId parameters
parameters.help_zh:
产品所属的阿里云账号ID。可登录物联网平台控制台，单击账号头像，跳转至基本信息页面查看账号ID。

TargetUid与TargetAliyunId参数至少传入一个
parameters.name: target_uid

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account to which the product belongs. To view the account, log on to the IoT Platform console, click the profile picture, and go to the Basic Information page to view the Logon Account.

You must specify at least one of the TargetUid and TargetAliyunId parameters
parameters.help_zh:
产品所属的阿里云账号。可登录物联网平台控制台，单击账号头像，跳转至基本信息页面查看登录账号。

TargetUid与TargetAliyunId参数至少传入一个
